provenance.implementation: Independent exhaustive finite-set enumeration from the definitions supplied for this task; no other source implementation consulted.

encoding.subset_mask: Subset A is encoded by the integer sum(2**i for i in A).
encoding.family_id: Family F is encoded by the integer sum(2**a for subset masks a in F). Bit 0 denotes the empty-set member.
encoding.family_catalogue: Every one of the 2**(2**n) families is listed, including the empty family and families containing the empty set.
encoding.pair_domain: All ordered pairs of admissible families; all true and false outcomes are retained.
encoding.component_domain: Nonempty admissible families with greatest member, with undirected edges when either F<=G or G<=F.
encoding.full_support_interpretation: For each fixed admissible G, full support means support(F)=support(G); maximality is within {admissible F : refinement_a(F,G)} under <=.
encoding.finite_scope: Exhaustive for n=1,2,3 only. Absence of a finite counterexample is not a proof for arbitrary ground sets.
